consumption.label: Consumption
consumption.text: Davco® K10 Plus is designed to be applied to substrates in a minimum 2 coat application to acheive a 1mm dry film thickness.

consumption.label: Consumption
consumption.text: Each coat shall be applied at a minimum thickness 0.75mm per coat at wet film thickness.

consumption.label: Consumption
consumption.text: Apply additional coats to acheive the minimum 1mm dry film requirements.

consumption.label: Consumption
consumption.text: A 20Ltr pail will cover approximately 13.3m2 with 2 coats applied.

consumption.label: Consumption
consumption.text: A 4Ltr pail will cover approximately 2.75m2 with 2 coats applied.

compat.text: Davco® K10 Plus is a premium performance, flexible, premixed, ready to use, water based polyurethane Class III waterproofing membrane designed for use under tile and stone and other resilient finishes.
compat.heading: DESCRIPTION

compat.text: Davco® K10 Plus is suitable for interior and exterior applications
compat.heading: USES

compat.text: Suitable as an anti fracture membrane
compat.heading: CHARACTERISTICS / ADVANTAGES

compat.text: Do not apply in temperatures above 35°C or below 5°C
compat.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

compat.text: Do not use in areas of permanent immersion such as swimming pools or ponds etc
compat.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

compat.text: Do not use where negative hydrostatic pressure is evident (rising damp), as if affects the bond of Davco® K10 Plus
compat.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

compat.text: Light Weight Blocks Apply 2 coats of a suitable Sika branded porous primer, allow to dry between coats.
compat.heading: SUBSTRATE QUALITY

compat.text: Prime metal surface with a suitable etching primer
compat.heading: SUBSTRATE QUALITY

compat.text: Building Boards and Sheeting Standard wall / floor building boards must be primed with a suitable Sika Branded primer and firmly fixed in accordance to manufacturer instructions and applicable Australian Standards
compat.heading: SUBSTRATE QUALITY

compat.text: Surfaces that are to receive Davco® K10 Plus shall be primed with a suitable Sika primer prior to the waterproofing membrane application
compat.heading: SUBSTRATE QUALITY / PRE-TREATMENT

storage.label: Conditions for safe storage
storage.text: Keep container tightly closed in a dry and well-ventilated place. Store in accordance with local regulations.

storage.label: Materials to avoid
storage.text: No special restrictions on storage with other products.

handling.label: Advice on protection against fire and explosion
handling.text: Normal measures for preventive fire protection.

handling.label: Advice on safe handling
handling.text: For personal protection see section 8. No special handling advice required. Follow standard hygiene measures when handling chemical products

handling.label: Hygiene measures
handling.text: When using do not eat or drink. When using do not smoke.

respiratory.label: Respiratory protection
respiratory.text: No special measures required. Respirator selection must be based on known or anticipated exposure levels, the hazards of the product and the safe working limits of the selected respirator.

hands.label: Hand protection
hands.text: Chemical-resistant, impervious gloves complying with an approved standard should be worn at all times when handling chemical products if a risk assessment indicates this is necessary. Follow AS/NZS 1337.1 Recommended: Butyl rubber/nitrile rubber gloves. Contaminated gloves should be removed.

skin_body.label: Skin and body protection
skin_body.text: Protective clothing (e.g. safety shoes, long-sleeved working clothing, long trousers) Follow AS 2210:3

engineering_controls.label: Appropriate engineering controls
engineering_controls.text: Use adequate ventilation and/or engineering controls to prevent exposure to vapours.
